public_rationale: Anthropic's June 4, 2026 statement proposed building systems for a future coordinated, verifiable slowdown or pause; it did not ask developers to halt development immediately [e1]. This supports the claim under the contract's immediate-halt reading [e1]. Anthropic nevertheless committed to helping build those systems and said it expected to slow or pause if comparable developers also did so verifiably [e1].
limitations: The assessment depends on distinguishing an immediate halt from advocacy for a conditional future pause.
The statement does not establish Anthropic's private intentions or whether it would eventually pause.
The evidence does not establish that every headline misrepresented the statement.
